Name: Stardew Valley But Everyday New Item
Author: Littlehouse9
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod makes it so everytime you sleep at 7:00pm (in game) or later it gives you a random item[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]The mod picks a random number 1-999 and gives you the amount chosen[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]For multiplayer compatibility all your friend(s) needs to do is install the mod and they'll get a random item themselves[/color]
This is inspired by the MC but mods 

[b]NOTE[/b]
if you want to have furniture and decor in the list of random items use the old version otherwise use the new version to use the old version go to files>old files click the drop down arrow and click manual or mod manager download

Manifest.Name: Stardew But Everyday New Item
Manifest.Description: Gives a random item and stack size to the player upon sleeping.
